snippet.title: Codename Kids Next Door: Operation B.E.S.T.  Promo (2004)
snippet.description:
Update: One of the game's creators has uploaded modern footage of the game! See it here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=POHNy6gOAa8&t

A trailer for the online Kids Next Door game "Operation B.E.S.T", where you, the viewer, could continue the missions started in the week's episode of KND. Ah, the stories I could tell...

If anyone can provide me with a copy of the game (it was downloadable) I will give them WHATEVER they want from my collection. (In a video file)
